channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 Alabama 911 Gulf Coast Conference (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 | Perdido Beach Resort | from $375. Perdido Beach Resort hosts the 2026 Alabama 911 Gulf Coast Conference starting Sunday, October 11, running through October 13. Nine-one-one professionals and industry partners gather for education on technology, operations, leadership, wellness, and training. Onsite registration October 11 through 13 runs $425.

item.title: Charity Chili Cookoff and Volleyball Tourney on Navarre Beach (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · tastings 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM, music 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM | Juana's Pagodas & Sailors' Grill | from $20. Caring and Sharing of South Santa Rosa County holds its 33rd annual chili and salsa cookoff with a beach volleyball tournament at Juana's Pagodas. Tastings run 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM for a $20 donation at the door, Goodbye August plays from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM, and winners and raffle prizes are announced at 4:00 PM. The money buys holiday food for families in South Santa Rosa County.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Indios Amigos Traveling Exhibit at Gulf Breeze and Pace Libraries (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 to Saturday 10/10 at Gulf Breeze · Monday 10/12 to Saturday 10/17 at Pace | Gulf Breeze Library, then Pace Library | No published price. Gulf Breeze Library and then Pace Library host a bilingual traveling exhibit from the Florida Public Archaeology Network for Hispanic Heritage Month. It tells the story of the Aztec artisans and warriors who sailed with Tristan de Luna's 1559 expedition to Pensacola. The display stays up all week at each branch, so it fits a quick stop on a library visit.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Live Music: Paradise Bar & Grill (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Tue/Fri/Sat 5:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM | Paradise Bar & Grill | Free. Beachside live music plays most nights on Pensacola Beach, with rotating local acts starting at 5:30 (Sundays 2:30). Wine Down Wednesday runs $3 house and $6 premium wines all day.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Repticon Fort Walton Beach: October 2026 (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sat 10/10 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Sun 10/11 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Destin Fort Walton Beach Fairgrounds and Events Center | from $6. Repticon comes to the Destin Fort Walton Beach Fairgrounds and Events Center Saturday, October 10, 9 AM to 4 PM, and Sunday, October 11, 10 AM to 4 PM. Admission is $15 for adults, $6 for ages 5 to 12, and free for ages 4 and under.

item.title: Supper Club at The Well: New Chef Debut (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · doors 5:30 PM · dinner 6:00 PM | The Well | from $100. The Well at Perfect Plain Brewing Company hosts its Supper Club on Sunday, October 11 with the first menu from the new head chef and the first cocktail list from the new beverage director. The dinner has five courses with paired cocktails and the menu is kept under wraps. Doors open at 5:30 PM and dinner starts at 6:00 PM.

item.title: The Boardwalk Columbus Day Weekend Celebration (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Mon 10/5 to Sun 10/11 · see the daily schedule | The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island | No published price. The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island runs a week of Columbus Day programming from October 5 to October 11, new for 2026. The schedule is a pirate show on Monday from 5:30 PM to 8:00 PM, a movie on the beach on Tuesday at 8:00 PM, karaoke on Wednesday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and karaoke followed by a fireworks show on Sunday.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Weekend Live Music: Sandshaker Lounge (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Every weekend · evenings | Sandshaker Lounge | Free. The Shaker, birthplace of the Bushwacker, has live music every weekend and never a cover. It is a classic Pensacola Beach dive, about 25 minutes from the bridge.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: Munson Heritage Festival (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 and Sunday 10/11 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Krul Recreation Area | No published price. The Munson Heritage Festival is a nonprofit weekend at Krul Recreation Area that shows how northern Santa Rosa and Okaloosa counties lived, with demonstrations of wood carving, basket weaving and Civil War reenactment. It suits families who like to watch old crafts done by hand, and children can stand close enough to see how it works. Krul Recreation Area is a forested state park with unreliable cell service, so plan the route before leaving Milton.

item.title: Pensacola Bay Ferry to Fort Pickens (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sat + Sun · runs 9 AM-6 PM | Downtown ferry landing → Fort Pickens → Pensacola Beach | from $20. Boat + fort + beach without the car: ranger narration across the bay, tunnels and batteries at Fort Pickens for engineering-minded kids, then the beach stop. Strollers roll aboard.

item.title: 27th Annual Emerald Coast Home & Boat Show (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 10:00 AM | Destin-Fort Walton Beach Convention Center | Free. The 27th Annual Emerald Coast Home & Boat Show fills the Destin-Fort Walton Beach Convention Center with more than 100 vendors selling home goods to boats. A lot of boats are parked outside for browsing too. Retail, health and pet-rescue booths line the aisles alongside giveaways, and admission is free for every age. The show returns every year.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Silly Witchy Water Paddle at LJ Schooners (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM | LJ Schooners Dockside Restaurant & Oyster Bar | No published price. LJ Schooners hosts a Silly Witchy Water Paddle on Sunday, October 11 from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at its dock in Niceville. The restaurant invites witches, warlocks and mermaid friends to bring a paddle, wear a costume and fill the bay with Halloween magic. Everyone in costume gets 10% off brunch.

item.title: Sunday Market on Palafox (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sundays · ~10 AM-3 PM | MLK Jr. Plaza, Downtown Pensacola | Free. The Sunday sibling of Palafox Market brings crafts, art, and prepared food. Confirm each week's market on their Facebook page before driving.

item.title: DiscipleStory (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sundays 9/13 – 10/18 (of an 8-week class) · 11:00 AM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 912 | No published price. An eight-week Sunday morning class at Crosspoint's Niceville campus walks participants through identifying their own story, passions, abilities and role in the church's mission. The class starts September 13 at 11 AM; the campus newsletter does not publish an end time.

item.title: Midday Melodies: Downtown Foley (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 · 11:00 AM | Heritage Park | No published price. Foley Main Street schedules a lunchtime concert at Heritage Park on Wednesdays in October, starting October 7 at 11:00 AM. The 2026 lineup is the Wiley Pete Duo on October 7, Dan Lee on October 14, This Side of 49 on October 21, and Tennessee Tim and Doug Drake on October 28. The 2025 series invited guests to bring a picnic blanket or lawn chair and pick up lunch from a nearby downtown restaurant.

item.title: Sunday Brunch with John Wheeler: Seville Quarter (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sundays · 11:00 AM-2:00 PM | Seville Quarter, Apple Annie's | No published price. Brunch runs in the courtyard room while John Wheeler plays through it. It is a daytime date that ends early enough to still leave a Sunday afterward.

item.title: Family Fun Day at Color Me Mine (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · studio open 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM | Color Me Mine | from $40. Color Me Mine Pensacola lists Family Fun Day on its October 2026 calendar for Sunday 10/11 and Sunday 10/25. One $40 ticket covers up to six painters instead of a studio fee for each person. The calendar does not say whether pottery is included, and the studio otherwise prices pieces separately from the studio fee. Ask at the studio before everyone picks a piece.

item.title: Brunch & Rally (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sundays · 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM | Pickleball at OWA | from $10. Pickleball at OWA runs indoor open play every Sunday afternoon, paired with a discount for anyone who shows a same-day receipt from Waffles R Wild. Open play costs $10 for nonmembers, members play free, and a Waffles R Wild receipt brings the nonmember rate down to $7. It repeats weekly, so today's session is one stop on an ongoing schedule.

item.title: Pokémon League at Trinity Games (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sundays · 1 PM-4 PM | Trinity Games | Free. Pokémon League at Trinity Games is a free weekly play session every Sunday from 1-4 PM at the shop in Pensacola. Trinity Games is a Wizards-certified Magic and trading card store with open play tables. The shop also runs other Pokémon events.

item.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Weekly Casual Play and Tournament (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sundays · 1 PM | GameMasters Guild | from $5. The Yu-Gi-Oh weekly tournament is an Advanced Constructed Yu-Gi-Oh TCG event at GameMasters Guild in Crestview, every Sunday at 1 PM. Entry is $5 including tax. Every player gets an OTS pack, and top placers get more.

item.title: CCB Crafts & Drafts: Halloween Edition (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County Brewing Company hosts a Halloween edition of Crafts & Drafts on Sunday, October 11 from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM. The brewery's listing opens with the line 'Something wicked this way comes'. The brewery is at 3041 E Olive Rd in Pensacola.

item.title: Wickedly Creative Witch Planter Workshop (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM | Coastal Makers | from $55. A Halloween-themed painted planter class at Coastal Makers, where each guest builds a witch-styled planter to take home over three hours. Materials and instruction are included in the price.

item.title: Afternoon of Stars: Mobile Opera Cast Showcase (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Sunday 10/11 · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Ben May Main Library, Bernheim Hall | Free. Members of Mobile Opera's upcoming Romeo and Juliet cast perform favorite selections in a free Sunday-afternoon showcase at Bernheim Hall inside Mobile's Ben May Main Library, followed by light refreshments. Mobile Opera's own event page marks the program free admission and runs it 3:00 to 4:30 PM; a separate library calendar listing gives a later 5:00 PM end time.

item.title: Make & Take Art: weekly drop-in art sessions (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Thursdays 8/27 through 12/3 · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Mobile Museum of Art | Free. The museum runs a free Thursday afternoon art session most weeks, working through materials and techniques borrowed from artists on view. Projects range from geometric shape painting to a Basquiat-inspired dinosaur build. The printed schedule also lists a session for September 8, but that date falls on a Tuesday, not a Thursday, so check with the museum first.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach: paint nights and all-ages sessions (weekly programme) (SUN 10/11)
item.description: Classes most weeks: Sunday 3 PM, Monday evenings, Saturday all-ages open studio | Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach | from $27. Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach is an artist-led canvas painting studio at 255 Miracle Strip Pkwy SE, Suite B-8, in the Publix shopping center in downtown Fort Walton Beach. October has an all-ages open studio, Halloween sessions, a book-lovers paint night and blacklight painting. Standard canvases cost $37-$39, all-ages sessions $27-$60 and Paint Your Pet $57-$59, and the studio is BYOB-friendly.
